changelog_v2: Consolidates draft 0.5 (UC-CASE-01 to UC-CASE-21) into one file and supersedes earlier case creation JSON files.
Platform aligned to web-browser-only alpha (card 56): 'tap' copy changed to 'select', phone notifications replaced by browser notifications, Apple guideline items moved to post_alpha_notes.
Coverage aligned to all 50 states, DC, and 5 territories (card 54): place pickers and attorney triggers updated.

Journey template aligned to the 2026-10-04 MVP (card 6): adds 'what to secure now' (card 59), funeral research only (card 52), all 10 government agencies always offered (card 15), and banks, insurers, and employers (card 16).
Journey and task statuses aligned to the card 50 data model. Trial fields aligned to the card 26 care rest rules.
UC-CASE-09 reconciled with the card 26 overwhelm threshold (three skips in a row).
UC-CASE-08 adds 'someone else is handling it' and the secure-now item.
UC-CASE-12 and UC-CASE-18 add the $14.99 subscription disclosure (legal review) and the no-billing-during-crisis rule.
New UC-CASE-22 Answer by speaking (speech input, audio never kept).
New UC-CASE-23 Long sessions: AI reminder at session start and every 3 hours, and the 45-minute rest offer (legal gate, card 26 DEC-26-02).
New UC-CASE-24 The user says they are under 18.
WCAG 2.2 AA and grade 8 plain language added as global rules with testable criteria (card 57).
instructions_for_claude_code: Read the existing codebase first. Map every entity, field, and state in this spec to the existing schema, migrations, RLS policies, and journey template loader before writing code. If the repo already implements an earlier version of this spec, diff against it and change only what this version changes.
Read cairn-account-use-cases-v32.json first. It owns the account entity, including all trial, access, subscription, and check-in fields. Do not create those fields from this file.
Read cairn-take-a-break-use-cases-v32.json for all break behavior. It owns the Take a break control, break screens, and rest offers.
Extend existing tables where a matching concept exists. Do not rename or drop existing tables or columns without asking the developer first.
Write schema changes as forward migrations. RLS: a case, its answers, and its tasks are readable and writable only by the authenticated user who owns the case.
Journey templates are content-as-code: versioned files in the repo, loaded read-only. Implement journey_selection as template data and rules, not hard-coded branches.
Implement every acceptance_criteria item as an automated test. Items tagged [SAFETY], [PRIVACY], or [LEGAL] are release blockers.
All user-facing copy is draft pending legal and clinical review. Store it in the copy or i18n layer, never inline in components.
Open decisions are configuration values with the stated default, changeable without a migration.
Never persist values listed in never_collect_at_case_creation. Redact before database writes, logs, analytics, and model requests, for typed text and speech transcripts alike.

This file defers to cairn-support-crisis-plan-v32.json for crisis detection, levels, rest, check-ins, break controls, and reply scripts. Where they differ, the crisis plan wins and the difference should be reported to the developer.
Do not build anything in out_of_scope_mvp.

confirmed_decisions.summary: The 28-day free period starts when the user selects Start journey on their first case. Saving or editing a draft never starts it.
No payment information at Start journey. The user is told this before and after selecting the button.
Exactly 28 days. Read-only on day 29 without a subscription. Nothing deleted or charged.
One free period per account. A second case does not restart or extend it.

confirmed_decisions.decision: The death certificate office is keyed on place of death. DMV and estate follow where the person lived.
A draft case with no user activity for 28 days is deleted automatically and permanently. Any activity resets the 28 days. No notifications are sent about drafts. The user is told at pause.
Pausing an active journey does not stop the free days, and Cairn says so.
Notifications are chosen by the user at journey setup. The only other outbound message is a confirmation of an action the user took, and Cairn says where it will go first.
confirmed_decisions.superseded_by: account D-13 (2026-10-05): channels and frequency are chosen at account setup. Journey setup confirms them and adds due date lead time and inactivity notices (UC-CASE-19). Action confirmations still follow UC-CASE-21.

confirmed_decisions.summary: A care rest (begins at level 2, 3, or 4) pauses the free days until the user returns to tasks or the rest ends. trial_ends_at moves later. The reason is never stored. Only while the free days are running. Never affects a paid subscription.
Rest is offered after about 45 minutes of active use and after a heavy task, at most once per session per trigger.
Level 2 starts on two overwhelm signals in one conversation, or three skipped questions in a row.
After level 3 or 4, Cairn asks once whether it may check in tomorrow. Only on a yes, one private check-in is sent.
Ending language not clearly about the paperwork is treated as risk of harm.

confirmed_decisions.decision: Alpha is web browser only, hosted on Cloudflare (updated 2026-10-06, replaces CloudFront). No native apps.
Coverage is all 50 states, DC, and all US territories and governed locations.

confirmed_decisions.summary: $14.99 a month for the whole account. The prompt never appears during a crisis conversation (crisis plan).

confirmed_decisions.decision: WCAG 2.2 AA and Federal Plain Language Guidelines at about a grade 8 reading level.
Users can talk to Cairn by text or speech. Audio is never kept.

Government notifications cover SSA, VA, IRS (what to know now), USCIS, DMV, Passport, voter registration, state social services, military retiree benefits, and federal employee benefits, all offered. The tracker includes banks, credit cards, lenders, life insurers, and employer or pension plans.

confirmed_decisions.summary: One label, Take a break, on every view. 988 line on break screens.

voice.override: At care levels 3 and 4 every voice uses the shared steady_care style.

pacing: No timers and no required question order.
Every question offers 'Skip for now' and 'I'm not sure'.
Never ask the same question twice in one session.
Missing answers become open items and never block a journey.
Three 'Skip for now' answers in a row start level 2 (see UC-CASE-09). Level 2 rest uses cairn-take-a-break-use-cases-v32.json UC-BRK-07..
global_rules.input_modes: Every question accepts a button, typed text, or speech (UC-CASE-22). Free text and transcripts are parsed only for data_fields keys, read back for confirmation, and everything else is discarded.
comfort_first_turn_contract: At most one question per turn.
End every turn with exactly one clear next action.
accessibility: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA on every case creation screen.
All copy and AI replies at about a grade 8 reading level per the Federal Plain Language Guidelines.
Large click targets for every choice plus a free-text box and a speak button.
No meaning carried by color alone.
'Read this to me' on every case creation screen.
Full keyboard operation and screen reader labels for every control, including the speak button.
global_rules.take_a_break: Owned by cairn-take-a-break-use-cases-v32.json. Take a break and a Support resources link are on every case creation screen (UC-BRK-01). In a draft it opens UC-BRK-04. On an active journey it opens UC-BRK-05.
global_rules.ai_disclosure: See UC-CASE-23. Applies to every signed-in session, not only case creation.
legal: Cairn never gives legal advice or presents itself as a substitute for an attorney.
Every state, territory, or agency claim carries a citation to the issuing authority shown next to it.
attorney_flag content shows the attorney referral line.
global_rules.notifications: Outbound messages follow the account notification_preferences (account D-13), plus action confirmations (UC-CASE-21), sign-in links, the trial-ending note (account D-14), an opted-in check-in (crisis plan DEC-26-04), and the break-ending notice (cairn-take-a-break-use-cases-v32.json UC-BRK-09). During a break, cairn-take-a-break-use-cases-v32.json UC-BRK-08 decides what is sent. Never marketing.
global_rules.billing_during_crisis: No subscription, price, or trial wording at care levels 3 and 4. The subscribe prompt is deferred until the user is back at level 1.

notes: full_legal_name and date_of_birth are asked later inside the task that needs them.
Immigration matters are asked only inside the USCIS step, and only as 'Did they have anything pending with USCIS?' (card 15).
The last 4 digits of an SSN, where the privacy policy allows them, are collected only inside a task, never at case creation.
user_age is never stored even if the user states it (UC-CASE-24).

draft_cleanup_job.audit: Log case id, user id, and time only.
must_not: Delete account.check_in_at unless check_in_case_id matches the deleted draft.

rules_used_here: trial_started_at is written in the same transaction that moves the first case from draft to active, and only if null.
No payment method is collected anywhere in case creation.

mvp_template_sections.note: Protect home, vehicles, pets, mail, valuables, and identity. Includes 'do not sell, give away, or divide anything yet' with attorney trigger.

Search and compare only. Cairn never schedules, books, contacts, or arranges. All provider data (contact details, services, hours, availability, and prices) comes from each provider's own website. Prices may be out of date, so Cairn always tells the user to contact the provider directly for current prices (decided 2026-10-06).

mvp_template_sections.rule: All agencies always appear. Qualifying questions are asked inside each step, not at case creation.

journey_selection.rule: Always produce a journey. Never block on missing answers.

use_cases.name: Start a new case
trigger: User selects 'Start a case' on the setup complete screen (account UC-REG-16) or the home screen (UC-CASE-25).
preconditions: account.status is setup_complete (account UC-REG-16). This includes adult attestation, all three acknowledgments, preferred name, voice, and notification preferences.
main_flow: Show the session-start AI reminder if due (UC-CASE-23).
Acknowledge the loss before asking anything.
Explain what happens next in one or two sentences.
Offer: 'Answer one question at a time' or 'Tell me in your own words' (typed or spoken).
Create the case with status draft.

alternate_flows.name: own_words
steps: Extract only data_fields keys from text or transcript.
Read back as a short list and ask 'Did I get that right?'
Ask only about missing fields.

copy.intro: I'll ask a few gentle questions so I can show you the steps that fit. You can skip anything, and you can stop and come back whenever you need.

acceptance_criteria: Creating a case sets status draft and does not touch trial fields.
First reply contains an acknowledgment and at most one question.
[PRIVACY] Free text and transcripts persist only data_fields keys.

use_cases.name: Share who you are to them
main_flow: Ask user_role. Answer changes wording only.

alternate_flows.name: power_of_attorney
alternate_flows.copy: A power of attorney usually ends when the person dies. After a death, the person named in the will as executor, or someone appointed by the court, usually takes over. An estate attorney can tell you what applies where you live.
alternate_flows.legal_review: Replace with a primary-source or uniform-act citation before launch.

alternate_flows.name: professional_fiduciary
steps: Offer a shorter pace and skipping explainers, regardless of voice.

acceptance_criteria: Skip stores default family_member.
POA note renders once per case with citation.

use_cases.name: Share what to call them
main_flow: Ask display_name and use it from then on.

alternate_flows.name: skipped
steps: Use 'your loved one', or 'the person who died' in plain_practical if the user prefers.

acceptance_criteria: display_name never appears in any outbound notification (UC-CASE-19 privacy rule).

use_cases.name: Share when and where the death happened
main_flow: Ask date_of_death.
Ask place_of_death with a 'State or territory' picker covering all 56 jurisdictions and optional county or city.
If the death was away from home, ask residence_jurisdiction.

alternate_flows.name: place_unknown
alternate_flows.copy: When you know where it happened, I can find the right office.

alternate_flows.name: outside_us
steps: Set outside_us true.
Explain kindly this is not covered yet, keep the case, suggest the funeral home and an attorney.

acceptance_criteria: Picker includes all 50 states, DC, PR, GU, VI, AS, and MP.
Certificate office uses place_of_death only. DMV uses residence_jurisdiction.
Approximate dates are accepted.

use_cases.name: Share how it happened
main_flow: Explain why before asking.
Show the five choices.
Confirm without repeating anything painful.

alternate_flows.name: user_volunteers_cause
steps: No follow-up questions.
Do not store the cause.
Acknowledge simply.
Raise distress sensitivity for the session.
If the user says the death was by suicide, set loss_survivor_resources and offer AFSP loss survivor support once, without pushing.

alternate_flows.name: prefer_not_to_say
steps: Accept with no follow-up. General path.

acceptance_criteria: [PRIVACY] Only the enum is persisted. Free text for this question is never stored or logged.
No follow-up after prefer_not_to_say.

use_cases.name: Share military service
main_flow: Ask veteran_status. Apply the veteran add-ons.
acceptance_criteria: VA and military retiree steps are never removed from the journey, only flagged probably_not_applicable when the answer is no.
No discharge papers requested during case creation.

use_cases.name: Share whether there is a will or estate plan
main_flow: Ask estate_plan_status.

alternate_flows.name: no_or_unknown
steps: Reassure this is common.
Add no_will_explainer with attorney flag.
Never explain inheritance rules in chat.

alternate_flows.name: family_disagreement
steps: Do not take sides.
Add 'Talk to an estate attorney' (UC-CASE-16).

acceptance_criteria: No document upload or request is offered.

use_cases.name: Share what has already been done
main_flow: Show the completed_items checklist.
Mark selected tasks done.

alternate_flows.name: none_or_unsure
steps: Related tasks stay open with needs_check true.

alternate_flows.name: someone_else_handling
steps: For any item the user can choose 'Someone else is handling this' and optionally add a name.
Task status handled_elsewhere.

acceptance_criteria: funeral_provider_chosen without ssa_notified changes the SSA step wording.
handled_by is optional and never required to continue.
Checklist includes the secure-now item and the bank, insurer, or employer item.

use_cases.name: Skip, say I'm not sure, or change an answer
main_flow: Every question shows 'Skip for now' and 'I'm not sure'.
Changes can be made by chat, speech, or the review screen. Recompute journey_selection and say what changed in one line.
rules: Three consecutive 'Skip for now' answers start level 2 (DEC-26-03). 'I'm not sure' does not count as a skip.
The level 2 message never suggests skipping was wrong.

copy.level_2_after_skips: We don't have to do all of this today. Would you like to rest for now, do one small thing, or just talk for a minute?

acceptance_criteria: answer_state values: answered, skipped, unsure.
A skipped question is not re-asked in the same session.
[SAFETY] The third consecutive skip triggers level 2. Two skips, or skips separated by an answer or an 'I'm not sure', do not.
Changing an answer on an active journey never removes progress on unaffected tasks.
open_items: OPEN-07: confirm with clinical review whether 'I'm not sure' should count toward the skip threshold.

use_cases.name: Pause and come back later
Review what you shared
main_flow: Show 'What you told me' and 'What we can figure out later', each line with Edit.
Ask 'Does this look right?'
acceptance_criteria: circumstance shows its enum label, never free text.

use_cases.name: See the journey that fits and start it
main_flow: Explain in one or two sentences why the journey fits.
Show weeks 1 to 4. Done items checked, handled_elsewhere items labeled, open items 'When you're ready', probably_not_applicable items shown last.
Confirm how Cairn keeps in touch (UC-CASE-19), skippable.
Show the pre-button notice.
Buttons: 'Start journey' and 'Not yet'.
On Start journey, in one transaction: status active, template key and version, journey_started_at, tasks created, and for a first case trial_started_at and trial_ends_at.
Show the confirmation with the end date in the user's local time zone.

alternate_flows.name: not_yet
steps: Stays draft. No trial change. Confirm saved.

alternate_flows.name: care_level_3_or_4
steps: Do not show pre-button notice or confirmation with trial or price wording. Setup waits until level 1.

copy.pre_button_notice: When you select Start journey, your 28 free days begin. They keep counting if you pause, unless Cairn suggests a rest because things have become too much. You won't need to enter any payment information now. Once you subscribe, a break never pauses or changes your subscription.
copy.confirmation_first_case: Your journey has started. Your 28 free days begin today and end on {trial_end_date}. You don't need to enter any payment information now. When your 28 days are up, we'll ask whether you'd like to subscribe. A subscription is $14.99 a month and covers all your cases. Taking a break doesn't pause a subscription. If you don't subscribe, nothing is charged, and your account becomes read-only. Nothing is deleted. A week before your free time ends, you'll see a reminder here in Cairn, and we'll also email it to {email}.

acceptance_criteria: trial_started_at set exactly once.
trial_ends_at = trial_started_at + 28 days + care-rest time.
[PRIVACY] No payment field, form, or SDK call anywhere in case creation.
Pre-button notice is visible before the button is enabled.
[SAFETY] No trial or price wording at care levels 3 and 4.
[LEGAL] Price and subscription wording approved by counsel before launch.
Both notices say a break never pauses or changes a subscription (BRK-D-08).

use_cases.name: Choose the first task
main_flow: Name the one or two most time-sensitive tasks with one line each on why.
Offer one small task.
Ask 'What feels doable right now?' with: recommended task, small task, 'Not today'.
Open the chosen task.

alternate_flows.name: not_today
steps: Confirm saved.
Say the free days keep counting while away, unless Cairn suggested a rest.
alternate_flows.copy: That's okay. Everything is saved, and we'll start right here when you come back. Your free days keep counting while you're away.
alternate_flows.note: Not today is not a break. It does not set break fields. Take a break is still on this view (cairn-take-a-break-use-cases-v32.json V-36).

rules: If pets or dependents are mentioned, the secure-now step is recommended first.
Funeral research is offered as research only.
acceptance_criteria: No task auto-starts.
'Not today' copy includes the free-days line (DEC-07).

use_cases.name: Signs of distress during case creation
use_cases.draft_case_note: In a draft there is no trial clock, so a care rest only stops questions and saves the draft.

check_in.rule: After level 3 or 4, offer the follow-up once (crisis plan DEC-26-04). On a yes, set account.check_in_at and account.check_in_case_id.
check_in.draft_channel: Uses the account notification channels chosen at setup. OPEN-08 resolved by account D-13.

acceptance_criteria: Crisis plan AC-26-01 to AC-26-08 and AC-26-10 pass on every case creation screen, for typed text and speech transcripts.
[SAFETY] Never ask for a promise to stay safe or describe methods (crisis plan level 4).
[PRIVACY] No distress classification or reason stored. Only trial_clock_paused_at and check_in_at.
[LEGAL] Each level 4 referral increments the anonymous monthly counter for SB 243 reporting (crisis plan data.safety_referral_count).
pending: Clinical sign-off by Kenneth Fulkroad (DEC-26-06) before any real user.
use_cases.scope: Case-creation-specific rules only. Levels, triggers, replies, rest, and check-ins are owned by the crisis plan (contexts draft_case and active_journey).

use_cases.name: Sensitive numbers typed or spoken
trigger: Typed text or a speech transcript matches an SSN, card number, or account number pattern
main_flow: Mask immediately.
Redact server-side before any write, log, analytics event, or model request.
Explain kindly without echoing.

copy.explanation: You don't need to share that right now. I've removed it to keep it safe. If a step needs it later, I'll tell you exactly who needs it.

acceptance_criteria: [PRIVACY] Redaction covers SSNs with or without dashes, partial SSNs, 13 to 19 digit card numbers with Luhn check, and long digit runs.
[PRIVACY] Spoken digit sequences in transcripts ('one two three...') are normalized before matching.
[PRIVACY] Reply never contains the value or a partial of it.

use_cases.name: Something Cairn should not guide alone
triggers: property in more than one state or territory
request to sell, move, or give away property early (card 59)
main_flow: Acknowledge.
Say plainly to talk with an estate attorney.
Add that as a task.
Keep every safe step visible.
rules: Where a state or territory step is a verified link only, show it with 'Please confirm with the office' (pending the card 54 legal review approach).
acceptance_criteria: Attorney task includes the attorney referral line.

use_cases.name: The death has not happened yet
main_flow: Acknowledge.
Explain journeys start after a death.
Offer save a draft or come back later.

copy.draft_notice: I've saved this for you. If it isn't opened for 28 days, it will be deleted automatically to protect your privacy. Opening it any time keeps it safe.

acceptance_criteria: 'Start journey' is not offered.
No trial start.

main_flow: Same as UC-CASE-01, acknowledging another loss.
At UC-CASE-19, read back the account notification choices. No per-case choices (account D-13).
At Start journey show the existing end date.

alternate_flows.name: account_read_only
steps: Draft can be created and edited.
Before Start journey, explain kindly a subscription is needed, $14.99 a month for all cases.
Open the subscribe flow (UC-SUB, card 55, not yet specified).

copy.confirmation_existing_trial: Your journey has started. Your free days still end on {trial_end_date}. You don't need to enter any payment information now.
copy.confirmation_subscribed: Your journey has started. It's included in your subscription.

acceptance_criteria: Trial fields unchanged by a second Start journey.
Subscribed accounts see no trial wording.
[SAFETY] Subscribe prompt never appears during levels 3 or 4.

use_cases.name: Confirm how Cairn keeps in touch
main_flow: Read back the account choices in one line: channels and how often (account UC-REG-15).
Ask, one question per screen: how early to hear about due dates (the day before, 3 days, or a week before), and whether to check in if it's been a while (no, after 3 days, a week, or 2 weeks).
Offer 'Change how you hear from me', which opens the account Settings items (account UC-REG-17) and returns here.
Save due_date_lead and inactivity_after on account notification_preferences.
Read back and confirm.

alternate_flows.name: skipped
steps: Keep the account choices and the OPEN-03 defaults for lead time and inactivity.

alternate_flows.name: frequency_none
steps: If the account frequency is No reminders, skip both questions and say plainly that nothing will be sent outside Cairn except confirmations.

alternate_flows.name: text_message
steps: Only if OPEN-05 enables it. Collect number just in time, verify by code, show consent line (account D-12).

copy.opening: Here's how I'll keep in touch: {channels}, {frequency}. You can change this any time.
copy.lead_time_question: How early would you like to hear about something that's due?
copy.inactivity_question: If it's been a while since you opened Cairn, would you like me to check in?
copy.example_notification: You have a step coming up in Cairn.

rules: Notification text never includes the person's name, the circumstance, or task details.
Nothing is sent outside Cairn while a rest is active, except an opted-in check-in or an action confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Channels and frequency are never asked from scratch here (account D-13).
Browser permission is never requested here unless the user chooses to add browser notifications.
[PRIVACY] Outbound text passes a check that it contains no display_name or circumstance.
post_alpha_notes: Native app push notifications and Apple App Review Guideline 4.5.4 apply once native apps ship (card 28).

use_cases.name: Confirmations for something the user just did
main_flow: Before the action, say on screen where the confirmation will go.
Send exactly one confirmation after the action.
rules: MVP confirmations: setup complete welcome (account UC-REG-16), a Settings change (account UC-REG-17), case deleted now, case deleted after 7-day hold, account deleted (account UC-ACCT-01).
Confirmations are sent even during a rest (crisis plan rest.while_resting).
acceptance_criteria: One confirmation per action, logged without content.

use_cases.name: Answer by speaking
trigger: User selects the speak button on any case creation question, or speaks in own-words mode
preconditions: Browser microphone permission granted. Requested only when the user first selects the speak button.
main_flow: Show a clear listening indicator and a stop button.
Convert speech to text.
Discard the audio immediately after conversion.
Run UC-CASE-15 redaction on the transcript.
Show the transcript on screen and ask 'Did I hear that right?' with Edit.
Process the confirmed text like typed input.

alternate_flows.name: permission_denied
steps: Say plainly that speaking needs microphone access, and that typing or buttons work the same.

alternate_flows.name: transcription_unclear
steps: Ask once to try again or type it. Never guess an answer for a field.

alternate_flows.name: distress_in_speech
steps: Crisis detection runs on the transcript exactly as on typed text (UC-CASE-14).

copy.first_use: You can talk instead of typing. I turn what you say into words on the screen, and I don't keep the recording.

acceptance_criteria: [PRIVACY] No audio is written to storage, logs, or analytics at any point.
[PRIVACY] Transcripts are redacted before persistence or any model request.
[SAFETY] Crisis detection applies to transcripts.
Speak button is keyboard operable and labeled for screen readers.
Speech is never required.
dependencies: Speech-to-text provider with contract terms confirming no audio retention and no training on user data (card 56).

use_cases.name: Long sessions: AI reminder
main_flow: At session start (at most once per day), show a short, clear notice that Cairn is an AI and not a person.
After every 3 hours of continuing interaction, show the notice again.

copy.ai_reminder: A quick reminder: I'm Cairn, an AI guide. I'm a computer program, not a person.

rules: The AI reminder is never skipped, including at care levels 3 and 4, but is shown gently and never interrupts a level 4 reply before 988 is shared.
Completing account UC-REG-09 counts as the session-start reminder for that day.
acceptance_criteria: [LEGAL] AI reminder shown at session start and at least every 3 hours of continuing interaction.
Reminders and offers are written at about grade 8 and announced to screen readers.
use_cases.legal_review: Owned by account UC-REG-09 legal_review (SB 243 and New York General Business Law Article 47). The reminder is built either way, per the pre-launch legal gate.
use_cases.scope: Every signed-in session, including account setup and returning sign-in.
use_cases.migrated_out: The 45-minute and heavy-task rest offer moved to cairn-take-a-break-use-cases-v31.json UC-BRK-06.

use_cases.name: The user says they are under 18
trigger: During case creation the user states or clearly indicates they are under 18
main_flow: If any distress signal is present, UC-CASE-14 comes first.
Acknowledge the loss warmly.
Explain that Cairn is made for adults and can't set up this case with them.
Encourage them to share this with a trusted adult, who can use Cairn.
Offer 988 (call or text) as someone to talk to any time.
Stop intake questions.

copy.message: I'm so sorry about your loss. Cairn is made for adults, so I can't set this up with you. A trusted adult, like a family member, a school counselor, or a coach, can help with these steps, and they can use Cairn. If you want to talk to someone right now, you can call or text 988 any time.

rules: Do not store the user's age or the statement.
Do not ask for proof of age.
The draft follows the normal 28-day deletion rule.
acceptance_criteria: [PRIVACY] No age value persisted.
[SAFETY] Distress handling runs before this flow.
No further intake questions after this message.
use_cases.legal_review: Account handling after a user indicates they are a minor, and alignment with the Terms of Use 18+ rule and SB 243 minor provisions.
use_cases.related: Account UC-REG-06 asks the adult question at setup. This use case covers a user who says otherwise later. Both follow OPEN-09. account.adult_attested is not changed by this flow until OPEN-09 is decided.

use_cases.name: Home screen
main_flow: Greet with the preferred name in one line.
On a break: show the resting screen first (cairn-take-a-break-use-cases-v32.json UC-BRK-08, screen S-06).
No cases: show one action, Start a case (UC-CASE-01), with one line saying the free days won't start until a journey starts.
Draft case: show its card with display_name, where they left off, the 28-day draft notice (UC-CASE-10), Keep going, and Delete.
Active journey: show its card with the next task and, on a trial, the free days end date. No trial wording at care levels 3 and 4.
Read-only account: show the read-only banner and Subscribe (UC-SUB, card 55) only at level 1.

copy.empty_state: When you're ready, we can start with the person who died. Your 28 free days won't start until you start a journey.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly one primary action on the empty state.
Meets the global accessibility rules.
[PRIVACY] Page title and browser tab never show display_name.
[SAFETY] No subscription or price wording at care levels 3 and 4.

uc_case_05.steady_direct: This next question helps me show the right steps. You don't need to share details. Was the death expected, or was it sudden?
uc_case_05.warm_patient: Take whatever time you need with this one. It helps me to know a little about how it happened, only in general terms. Had they been ill, or was it sudden? You can also skip this.
uc_case_05.brisk_businesslike: One question that changes the plan: was this expected or sudden? A general answer is enough.
uc_case_05.plain_practical: Whether a death was expected or sudden changes who signs the death certificate and how long it can take. Which was it? You can skip this.
uc_case_05.steady_care: We can set all of this aside. I'm here. You don't have to do anything right now.

uc_case_19.steady_direct: I can let you know when something is due. How would you like to hear from me? You can also choose to hear from me only when you open Cairn.
uc_case_19.warm_patient: Some people like a gentle nudge, and some would rather not hear from anyone for a while. Both are fine. How would you like me to keep in touch, if at all?
uc_case_19.brisk_businesslike: Notifications: email, text, browser notifications, or none. Which do you want?
uc_case_19.plain_practical: I can tell you when something is due. I won't send anything you don't choose. How should I reach you, if at all?

suite.name: Cairn signup through first journey, v3.1 suite

files.cairn-account-use-cases-v32.json: Owns the account entity (including break fields), sign-in, sessions, setup acknowledgments, preferred name, voice, notification preferences, Settings, and account deletion.
files.cairn-case-creation-use-cases-v32.json: Owns cases, intake, journey selection, Start journey, the home screen, and action confirmations.
files.cairn-support-crisis-plan-v32.json: Owns crisis detection, care levels, care rest triggers and the trial pause, the follow-up check-in, and support resources. Wins on crisis behavior.
files.cairn-take-a-break-use-cases-v32.json: Owns the Take a break control, every break screen, Cairn's rest offers, what is sent or held during a break, the break-ending notice, and coming back.
files.cairn-subscription-use-cases-v33.json: Owns subscribing, Stripe checkout and events, renewal, failed payments, cancelling, and subscription notices.

suite.rule: Each decision and each field has exactly one owner file. Other files reference it by ID and do not restate it.
